audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander makes Master Yi 'immune to all slowing effects' — Riot's text says so in those words — and the page never mentions it once. Olaf's entire pattern is Undertow's slow keeping the target inside Reckless Swing's 325 range. Compounding it, whys[4] claims Ragnarok gives 'CC immunity and speed' so 'he cannot disengage': Ragnarok grants armour, MR and disable immunity, no movement speed, and under Highlander he disengages freely. Two more: Alpha Strike makes him UNTARGETABLE for its duration (20s at rank 1, reduced by his basic attacks), so an E thrown into it is wasted; and the true damage the page pins on 'Alpha' is Wuju Style (E, 14s), not Alpha Strike.
audit.why: This inverts the level-6 plan completely. The page tells the player their ultimate wins the all-in because he cannot disengage — the truth is his ultimate is up every 85 seconds against your 100, it turns off the slow your whole kit depends on, and Wuju Style's true damage walks straight through the resists Ragnarok gives you. A player following the current text presses R into a Highlander and watches him leave. Meditate is also a 10-second channel that any CC would break, and Olaf has no hard CC — so the answer is Grievous Wounds, which appears nowhere.
audit.corrected: Highlander's slow immunity and 85s cooldown written into whys[4], spikes[1].text, spikes[3], wants.you[1], wants.foe[2], content.mid and content.late. Alpha Strike's untargetability and Meditate's anti-heal answer written into content.early. whys[6] now credits Wuju Style with the true damage.
